results.headline: Solvay third quarter 2026 results
results.key_quote: We continue to navigate a challenging economic environment. The conflict in the Middle East is having a significant impact on Solvay operations, with the temporary shutdown of our Peroxides plant in Jubail materially affecting the company's short-term performance, as reflected in our updated guidance.
results.summary: Solvay reported Q3 2026 results materially below expectations. Underlying net sales declined 3.3% organically, EBITDA fell 26.6% organically with margin compression of 5.4 percentage points, and net profit declined significantly from €90m to €35m year-on-year. The company revised guidance downward on October 19th, now expecting EBITDA between €720-740m (down from prior expectations) and FCF between €120-150m. The decline is driven by the Middle East conflict impact (€25m in Q3 alone on Peroxides plant shutdown) and weakness in the soda ash market. While structural cost savings of €25m were achieved in Q3, these were insufficient to offset operational headwinds.

For the year as a whole, we now expect the earnings margin and free cash flow figures to exceed our initial projections.
results.summary: Continental raised its full-year 2026 outlook for continuing operations following strong Q3 results. The company exceeded expectations with adjusted EBIT margin of 14.9% (vs. 13.9% prior year), up 6.7% in absolute EBIT to €514m, and achieved record net income of €349m vs. -€756m loss in Q3 2025. Management explicitly stated earnings and free cash flow will 'exceed initial projections' for the full year, representing an upward guidance revision. While organic sales declined 1.5% and adjusted free cash flow fell 69% quarter-on-quarter (impacted by raw material costs), the profitability improvements and explicit guidance upgrade clearly position results ahead of expectations.

results.summary: CGI's NAV returned 5.3% year-to-date and 3.9% over 12 months, significantly underperforming its S&P/TSX Composite benchmark which returned 14.4% and 20.4% respectively. The company's share price performance (10.3% YTD, 16.4% 12-month) also lagged the benchmark substantially. No explicit expectations or guidance were provided, but the direct comparison to benchmark performance demonstrates material underperformance.

results.headline: Final Results for the Year Ended 31 May 2026
results.key_quote: It has been a year of real operational progress: the Company's mining rights at Lahtojoki were formally registered, the priority Anomaly 5 diamond target in the Kuhmo region was drilled for the first time with encouraging initial results, and the exploration programme for nickel, copper and platinum group elements in Northern Ireland was advanced on several fronts.
results.summary: Karelian Diamond Resources reported final results for the year ended 31 May 2026 with operational highlights including securing mining rights at Lahtojoki after 8+ years, completing a 334-metre drilling programme at Anomaly 5 with encouraging results (olivine lamproite intersections), and advancing exploration in Northern Ireland. However, no financial metrics, profit/loss figures, or comparisons to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance are provided in the announcement. The company describes the year as 'real operational progress' but this is a qualitative assessment of project milestones rather than a quantitative performance versus expectations comparison.
